data.name: Mason Dixon Saloon
data.tagline: Good Food. Cold Drinks. Great Times.
data.about: If you're a meat connoisseur, you know the difference an in-house smoker can make. You won't be disappointed when you visit Mason Dixon Saloon for delicious smoked meats. We smoke our pork baby back ribs and slow cook the meat for our Reubens. We even have a special dry rub for wings, burgers, pork baby back ribs, pork loins and beef loins.

data.name: The Holler Inn
data.tagline: Where Small Town Folks Get Fed Right.
data.about: The Holler Inn is a trailside bar and grill in downtown Browntown, Wisconsin, right off Highway 11 and the Cheese Country ATV and snowmobile trail. We serve pizza, wraps, fresh never frozen burgers and ice cold beer, with live music, karaoke and raffles through the year. Stop in after a ride, bring the whole crew, and we will take care of you.

feature.desc: Our signature hand mixed smashed patty topped with smoked Gouda cheese, crispy fried onion petals on our house made 'Boss Sauce', a creamy smoky sauce with just the right amount of tang and attitude.
feature.source: Our entry in the Green County Beef Producers' Best Burger Contest.
feature.howTitle: How the Best Burger Contest works
feature.howSub: Run by the Green County Beef Producers. Every contest burger you eat earns a stamp on your voting card.
steps: Order the contest burger and ask your server for a voting card.
Get your card stamped before you leave. One burger is one stamp, so if you share a burger, you share the vote.
Try at least half of the contest burgers (12 of 24 in 2026) for your vote to count.
Each burger you try adds a point to your favorite. Try all of them and your #1 gets the most points.
Send your card to the Green County Beef Producers by August 6.
12 or more stamps puts you in the gift card drawing. Try every burger to enter the beef bundle grand prize drawing.
feature.note: Voting runs April 1 to July 31 each year. The 2027 contest starts April 1, 2027.

data.name: BUZ Coffee & Energy
data.tagline: Coffee, energy drinks and good vibes in downtown Dubuque.
data.about:
BUZ is a walk-up coffee and energy shop on the corner of West Second and Locust in downtown Dubuque. We pour locally roasted Verena Street Coffee and zero-calorie, zero-sugar Bang Energy, with a long list of flavors and plenty of milk options.
Order at the covered walk-up counter and you're on your way in minutes.
